messages:
Jordan: Ran a quick multi-region A100 vs H100 sweep for prefills+decode on falcon-7b / llama-2-7b-chat / mistral-7b. Mixed-precision AWQ int8x4 vs FP16 baseline. Notable: H100 in us-west1 hit thermal-induced kernel redispatch during sustained prefill, causing p99 decode spikes (~460ms) and tokens/sec drop ~22% vs A100.
Anna: Do you have the run command and driver/runtime versions?
Jordan: Command + runtime:
```
./bench_runner --model=falcon-7b --quant=awq-int8x4 --prefill=1024 --decode=512 --qps=5 --region=us-west1
CUDA 12.2 / driver 535.113 / triton-runtime 2.6 / cutlass-opt kernels enabled
```
Jordan: Snippet from dmesg/syslog during spike: `GPU0 thermal_alert: throttle -> kernel_fallback=cuBLAS->cuSOLVER` and our runtime logged `redispatch_to_fallback=true`
Priya: Interesting — can you paste tokens/sec and $/1M tokens numbers across regions and SKUs? Need for cost modeling.
Jordan: Numbers (single-GPU averages, int8x4 prefills+decode mix):
- us-west1 A100: 12.8k t/s, p99 decode 180ms, $/1M tokens = $2.5
- us-west1 H100: 9.9k t/s, p99 decode 460ms (during thermal), $/1M tokens = $3.1
- eu-west1 A100: 12.4k t/s, p99 190ms, $/1M = $2.6
- eu-west1 H100: 12.1k t/s, p99 200ms, $/1M = $2.7
(note: H100 stable in eu-west1, only us-west1 showed thermal issues)
Sara: Did AWQ quant cause quality regressions vs FP16? Evaluation on our validation set?
Jordan: Small delta — AWQ int8x4 averaged 0.7% higher perplexity and 0.3% lower rouge across chat prompts on falcon-7b. For most customer prompts quality still acceptable; but will flag for models on tight-SLO pipelines.
Mike: From infra side, us-west cluster had sustained 95% GPU power draw and unusual ambient temps. We've scheduled a rack-level fan check and power-capping experiment. Also re: driver 535 — we're rolling an updated build to test.
EvalBot: AUTO-SUMMARY: H100 shows higher peak throughput normally but sensitive to sustained prefill patterns in some racks; kernel redispatch + thermal leads to worse p99 and cost under long prefill workloads. Action items: reproduce on clean rack, try power-capping, test CUDA 12.3/driver 540, capture perf counters (SM utilization, thermal).
Jordan: Plan: repro in eu-west on H100 with stress prefill to isolate rack vs driver. I'll create a tiny benchmark PR with logs + perf counters. Putting a short TODO: reproduce -> infra check -> file bug with vendor if persists. :mechanical_arm:
Anna: Thanks — please add the exact job ids and the dump from `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,clocks.sm,pcie.link.width --format=csv` to the issue.
